q: A person presents with acute chest pain. Nitroglycerine was given sublingually and the pain relieved within 5 minutes. what is the mechanism of the drug?

This ultimately results in the dephosphorylation of myosin light chains within smooth muscle fibers. This activity causes the relaxation of smooth muscle within blood vessels, resulting in the desired vasodilatory effect.
